items.question: How many students is Dubai Municipality's 'Promoting healthy nutrition in educational institutions' initiative aiming to reach?
items.gold: Over 300,000 students in schools across the emirate of Dubai.
items.fact: Dubai nutrition initiative aims to reach over 300,000 students

items.question: Which federal food safety law must schools in Abu Dhabi comply with under the Department of Education and Knowledge's school nutrition policy?
items.gold: Federal Law No. 10 of 2015 on Food Safety.
items.fact: Abu Dhabi school food policy requires Federal Law No. 10 of 2015
